purpose: Durable progress record for the Jastrow/Krupnik meaning-equivalence audit.

baseline.realReaderPhraseExtractorAudit: All 686 retained source-scoped mappings passed the Chromium audit against JastrowReadingView.phrases on 2026-11-24.
baseline.distinctSensePolicy: preserve distinct senses; never merge by headword or token overlap alone
baseline.sourcePolicy: each accepted mapping must be grounded in original source records and exact reader-displayed phrases
baseline.exactGlossNormalization: Deterministic canonical matching now consolidates complete gloss lists that differ only by punctuation, alternative order, leading articles, or coordinated active/passive infinitive markers; verb voice and word order within each alternative remain significant.

historicalCheckpoint.note: The earlier 29/43 checkpoint did not record the 43 candidate identifiers or the 29 completed identifiers. Do not infer completion from the number of data shards or from the reviewed-pair count.

reconstruction.note: These physical shard counts do not equal the historical 43 audit batches. The candidate inventory must be regenerated from shared consonantal headwords, original glosses, and the real reader phrase extractor.

rules: Generate candidates only where Jastrow and Krupnik records share an attested consonantal headword or alias.
Use only phrases emitted by JastrowReadingView.phrases for Jastrow-side meanings.
Compare individual senses, not whole-entry summaries.
Exclude exact-identical glosses already handled by ordinary exact matching.
Record every candidate as pending, accepted, rejected-distinct-sense, or rejected-not-displayed.
Keep original source references and exact source wording for every decision.
Candidate discovery uses token overlap only to rank a review queue; it never automatically merges senses.

candidateInventory.status: generated; 5,114 conservative candidate gloss pairs remain pending human review after excluding deterministic exact-gloss formatting variants, previously reviewed source pairs, explicit grammatical conflicts, pointed-headword conflicts, and active/passive mismatches
candidateInventory.note: This is a regenerated inventory from the current PR branch and current source data. It is a review queue, not a synonym certification; lexical overlap only ranks candidates and never triggers automatic fuzzy merging.

reviewedTranche.note: Seven additional candidate pairs were checked against their shared headwords, source glosses, and real reader-extracted Jastrow phrases. All seven passed the full source/provenance and phrase-extractor tests.

hebrewConsolidation.status: shared grouping layer in Hebrew reader and quick lookup; exact Hebrew alternative lists now consolidate despite punctuation/order differences
hebrewConsolidation.sources: Krupnik/Silbermann Hebrew source records only; the Hebrew plugin does not load Jastrow
hebrewConsolidation.safeguards: Original Krupnik/Silbermann Hebrew wording is authoritative. Exact Hebrew glosses and exact alternative-list variants consolidate; word order within each phrase, explicit grammatical label conflicts, and unreviewed synonyms remain separate. Source-scoped synonym pairs require manual review.
hebrewConsolidation.candidateReview: The initial English-gloss alignment filter found no pairs. The inventory was broadened to list every non-identical meaning pair across repeated normalized headwords for manual review.
hebrewConsolidation.note: Added deterministic normalization for exact Hebrew alternative lists: punctuation and alternative order are normalized, while phrase word order is preserved. Regression tests verify that unreviewed synonyms remain separate.
